1758 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 05-22 to end of 1758: May (9 days left) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) + September (30) + October (31) + November (30) + December (31) = 223 days.  
325 - 223 = 102 days into 1759. January (31) + February (28) + March (31) = 90 days, leaving 12 days into April → April 12, 1759.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1759-04-12
